**Finding: compliant** — no redline proposed.

Section 13 satisfies the preferred LICENSE position on every material term:

- **Affiliates and contractors (13.1):** the hosted-Services grant runs to "Customer, its Affiliates, and contractors acting on their behalf," with Authorized User pass-through — no written-notice gate, so this exceeds the fallback.
- **Paid-up licences (13.2):** "perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid," including modification/derivative rights and contractor support, and extending to Affiliates.
- **No revocation at will (13.3):** Vendor may revoke or suspend only during a material uncured payment or use breach affecting the licensed item, after notice and a reasonable cure opportunity.
- **Transferability (13.3):** transfer permitted to an Affiliate or successor in connection with a permitted assignment.
- **Consistency check (14.3):** Vendor Technology embedded in or required to use a Deliverable is expressly covered by the 13.2 perpetual licence, with pre-delivery identification and a bar on restrictive third-party material.

The use restrictions in 13.4 are ordinary and carve out lawful reverse engineering, authorized security testing, and Customer Data/output, so they do not narrow the grant below the playbook position.
